card.name: Words leading into electron microscopy
card.fires_on: Words just before the expected term "electron" or "electron microscope" in cell-biology imaging text, such as "an", "of", "used" and "employed". Also words inside imaging phrases like serial cross-sections or ultrastructure.

modes.description: Small words or verbs that come just before "electron microscope" or "electron microscopy".
